messages:
lee: Heads-up: Orion demo week - exec needs go/no-go by EOD. Blockers: telemetry ingestion failing + unclear committed pricing for sustained load. Who can own each?

maya: i'll own pricing. need expected sustained rps and avg tokens to size dedicated commit vs hosted.

noah: they reported ~100 rps steady, ~2.8k tokens per request, spikes to ~260 for ~90s. cc @maya.

tara: telemetry issue: our collector rejects with 415; client is sending 'application/json; charset=utf-16'. quick workaround: S3 drop + batch pull. can stand that up in ~2 hours if they approve bucket policy.

maya: pricing plan: i'll prepare two SKU lines: (A) Hosted with throttling and fallback model (monthly est), (B) Dedicated committed capacity (monthly + term). ETA 60-90m.

lee: security asks: retention window and encryption. we shared SOC2 summary. retention default 30d for POC, optional 90d with signed addendum.

ops-bot: Reminder: ingest cluster patch window at 23:00 UTC may interrupt tests.

noah: owners: @tara telemetry fallback, @maya pricing, @lee exec note. escalate to exec-bridge if we miss COB. keep updates terse.

maya: will post numbers in ~75m.

tara: starting S3 prep but need cross-account policy from customer.

lee: perfect. i'll draft the 3-bullet exec update once pricing and S3 confirm in. :thumbsup:
